title: Hallelujah, What a Savior!
description: Hallelujah, What a Savior! in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 5 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Philip Paul Bliss, first published in 1875. The tune, HALLELUJAH WHAT A SAVIOR, is by Philip Paul Bliss (1875). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Man of Sor-rows! what a name For the Son of God, who came Ru-ined sin-ners to re-claim. Hal-le-lu-jah! What a Sa-vior!

lines: Man of Sorrows! what a name
For the Son of God, who came
In my place condemned He stood;
Sealed my pardon with His blood.
Spotless Lamb of God was He;
Lifted up was He to die;
When He comes, our glorious King,
All His ransomed home to bring,
Then anew His song we'll sing:
